title: Quarkus app fails to start when generics are used in GraphQL endpoint
body:
**Describe the bug**
I added `@Query` to the GraphQL endpoint which returns object with Java generics (implemented in  smallrye/smallrye-graphql#281). Quarkus 1.8.1.Final application startup fails with exception then.

**Expected behavior**
Quarkus app starts and handles GraphQL API correctly

**Actual behavior**
```
2020-09-21 13:00:11,656 ERROR [io.qua.run.boo.StartupActionImpl] (Quarkus Main Thread) Error running Quarkus: java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException
	at java.base/jdk.internal.reflect.NativeMethodAccessorImpl.invoke0(Native Method)
	at java.base/jdk.internal.reflect.NativeMethodAccessorImpl.invoke(NativeMethodAccessorImpl.java:62)
	at java.base/jdk.internal.reflect.DelegatingMethodAccessorImpl.invoke(DelegatingMethodAccessorImpl.java:43)
	at java.base/java.lang.reflect.Method.invoke(Method.java:566)
	at io.quarkus.runner.bootstrap.StartupActionImpl$3.run(StartupActionImpl.java:134)
	at java.base/java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:834)
Caused by: java.lang.ExceptionInInitializerError
	at java.base/jdk.internal.reflect.NativeConstructorAccessorImpl.newInstance0(Native Method)
	at java.base/jdk.internal.reflect.NativeConstructorAccessorImpl.newInstance(NativeConstructorAccessorImpl.java:62)
	at java.base/jdk.internal.reflect.DelegatingConstructorAccessorImpl.newInstance(DelegatingConstructorAccessorImpl.java:45)
	at java.base/java.lang.reflect.Constructor.newInstance(Constructor.java:490)
	at java.base/java.lang.Class.newInstance(Class.java:584)
	at io.quarkus.runtime.Quarkus.run(Quarkus.java:60)
	at io.quarkus.runtime.Quarkus.run(Quarkus.java:38)
	at io.quarkus.runtime.Quarkus.run(Quarkus.java:106)
	at io.quarkus.runner.GeneratedMain.main(GeneratedMain.zig:29)
	... 6 more
Caused by: java.lang.RuntimeException: Failed to start quarkus
	at io.quarkus.runner.ApplicationImpl.<clinit>(ApplicationImpl.zig:408)
	... 15 more
Caused by: java.lang.NullPointerException
	at io.quarkus.deployment.steps.SmallRyeGraphQLProcessor$buildExecutionService-1556698146.deploy_3(SmallRyeGraphQLProcessor$buildExecutionService-1556698146.zig:8062)
	at io.quarkus.deployment.steps.SmallRyeGraphQLProcessor$buildExecutionService-1556698146.deploy(SmallRyeGraphQLProcessor$buildExecutionService-1556698146.zig:55)
	at io.quarkus.runn
```


**To Reproduce**
Clone https://github.com/velias/quarkus-qraphql-generics-example and run it

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - Output of `uname -a` or `ver`: `Linux mymachine-T480s 5.4.0-47-generic #51~18.04.1-Ubuntu SMP Sat Sep 5 14:35:50 UTC 2020 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux`
 - Output of `java -version`: `openjdk version "11.0.8" 2020-07-14
OpenJDK Runtime Environment (build 11.0.8+10-post-Ubuntu-0ubuntu118.04.1)
OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM (build 11.0.8+10-post-Ubuntu-0ubuntu118.04.1, mixed mode, sharing)`
 - GraalVM version (if different from Java): 
 - Quarkus version or git rev: 1.8.1.Final
 - Build tool (ie. output of `mvnw --version` or `gradlew --version`):  `Apache Maven 3.6.3 (cecedd343002696d0abb50b32b541b8a6ba2883f)
Java version: 11.0.8, vendor: Ubuntu, runtime: /usr/lib/jvm/java-11-openjdk-amd64
Default locale: en_US, platform encoding: UTF-8
OS name: "linux", version: "5.4.0-47-generic", arch: "amd64", family: "unix"
`

**Additional context**
FYI @phillip-kruger, I'm not sure what is wrong there, GraphQL works if generics are not used, so it is caused by generics definitely. It might be related to the loading of some info about generic types (either in jandex index or reflection) which is necessary to handle generics. But exception comes from some generate code and I'm not sure how to ger teal cause.
Also we should probably add some test into smallrye-graphql integration in Quarkus to catch this kind of problems during quarkus integration builds.
